title: Operational analytics workspace
problem: A small online business needs to understand business health quickly, investigate anomalies and compare recent performance without drowning in dashboard chrome.

users.description: Time-poor owner/operator who checks performance several times per day and is not a specialist data analyst.
primaryJobs: Understand current business health in under 30 seconds
Compare the current period with the previous period
Inspect the source of a change without leaving the workspace

productGoals: Make the most important change and its likely cause obvious
Support fast scanning followed by progressive drill-down
Remain usable with imperfect, empty and delayed data
requiredFlows: Filter or inspect a meaningful segment

requirements: Status and trend information not conveyed by color alone

constraints: No authentication required for the benchmark
Use deterministic local fixtures; no live commercial data dependency
Prefer mature accessible UI/charting infrastructure over bespoke primitives when it improves the result
antiGoals: No charts whose purpose is only visual polish
No hidden mobile horizontal overflow for core content
No reliance on hover for essential information
acceptanceCriteria: A first-time evaluator can identify whether performance is improving or declining
At least one anomaly can be inspected from summary to supporting context
All required viewports produce reviewable screenshots
Automated accessibility scan output is recorded
The result can be judged from a real rendered implementation
